relations.note: Sahagún compared Tezcatlipoca with Jupiter because of perceived supremacy and governance.
Tonacatecuhtli fathers Tezcatlipoca and the other creator brothers.

relations.note: Tonacacihuatl mothers Tezcatlipoca and the other creator brothers.

relations.note: Tezcatlipoca and Quetzalcoatl are separate sons within a group of creator brothers.

relations.note: They collaborate to lower, attack, and divide the many-mouthed earth being.
Tezcatlipoca and Quetzalcoatl attack and tear apart the many-mouthed earth being.
Tezcatlipoca and Quetzalcoatl transform her divided body into the ordered earth.
Quetzalcoatl strikes Tezcatlipoca down, prompting his transformation into a jaguar.
Tezcatlipoca casts down Quetzalcoatl's sun and raises the age-ending wind.
Creator gods install Tlaloc as ruler of a later sun; Tezcatlipoca's role varies.
relations.source: Historia de los mexicanos por sus pinturas

relations.note: Tezcatlipoca impugns her generosity, making her weep until a flood destroys the world.
Tezcatlipoca reveals his aged embodied face in a mirror, producing shame and destabilization.
Tezcatlipoca and fellow sorcerers induce him to drink pulque, precipitating transgression and departure.
Ihuimecatl cooperates with Tezcatlipoca in deceptions against Quetzalcoatl and Tollan.
Toltecatl cooperates with Tezcatlipoca in deceptions against Quetzalcoatl and Tollan.
Tezcatlipoca's transformations provoke desire, commerce, dancing, war, and humiliation involving Huemac.
Later chronicles say Tezcatlipoca took Xochiquetzal from Tlaloc.
Unstable later traditions describe a sexual or marital appropriation of Xochiquetzal.
Colonial traditions present an unstable rivalry between Tezcatlipoca and Tlaloc over Xochiquetzal.
Their images and rites overlap within the conquest-period Toxcatl festival complex.
relations.source: Florentine Codex, Books II and XII

relations.note: Some cosmologies and reconstructions associate him with the disputed Red Tezcatlipoca.
Regional cosmologies variably associate Camaxtli with the disputed Red Tezcatlipoca.
Regional cosmologies variably associate Mixcoatl with the disputed Red Tezcatlipoca.
Manuscript attributes closely join this jaguar night and cave power with Tezcatlipoca.
Almanacs link Itztli's obsidian knife and nocturnal judgment with Tezcatlipoca.
A woman embodying Xochiquetzal ceremonially accompanies Tezcatlipoca's impersonator as a wife.
A woman embodying Xilonen ceremonially accompanies Tezcatlipoca's impersonator as a wife.
A woman embodying Atlatonan ceremonially accompanies Tezcatlipoca's impersonator as a wife.
A woman embodying Huixtocihuatl ceremonially accompanies Tezcatlipoca's impersonator as a wife.
